# A plank of the crumbling bridge. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.561 0.337 0.231 --no-slot
material new Rope --base-color 0.851 0.627 0.400 --no-slot
add mesh cube --size 1 --name Board --location 0 0 -0.07
scale 0.94 0.8 0.14
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --size 1 --name RopeA --location -0.36 0 -0.07
scale 0.07 0.84 0.18
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Rope
add mesh cube --size 1 --name RopeB --location 0.36 0 -0.07
scale 0.07 0.84 0.18
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Rope
select Board RopeA RopeB
active Board
join
rename Board Plank
select all
shade flat
export plank.glb
